PART IV (B) — LOCAL GOVERNMENT
Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
NOTICE OF POLL
Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262)
NOTICE UNDER SECTION 38(1)
ELECTION OF CHAIRMAN, VICE CHAIRMAN AND MEMBERS OF ELPITIYA PRADESHIYA SABHA

NOTICE is hereby given under Section 38(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance that the above election iscontested and that a poll will be taken between 7.00 a.m. and 4.00 p.m. on 11.10.2019 and that,

(a) the names of the candidates in the first nomination paper as indicated by the candidates of each RecognizedPolitical Party for Election as Chairman, Vice Chairman and Members of the above mentioned LocalAuthority, the numbers and names of the respective wards and the names of candidates in the secondnomination paper to be returned ; and the approved election symbol allotted to each party ; and
(b) the situation of the polling station or stations and the particular polling stations reserved for femalevoters in the polling districts of the above mentioned electoral area.
are as specified in the schedule below.
2. The order in which the name of each Recognized Political Party appearing in the Schedule below is the sameorder in which these particulars will be printed on the ballot paper.

K. U. CHANDRALAL,Returning Officer, Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha,Assistant Returning Officer,Galle Administrative District,for Returning Officer.02nd day of September, 2019,Galle District Elections Office.
